title: How Figma's databases team lived to tell the scale
engineering_principles: Take incremental, reversible steps; tailor the sharding layer to the real query mix; prefer known low-risk options over uncertain rewrites.
practical_examples: Colos share a sharding key (UserID, FileID, OrgID); logical sharding via Postgres views before physical sharding; Go DBProxy with planners and load shedding; no atomic cross-shard transactions; first sharded table shipped September 2023 after about nine months.
why_it_matters: Shows how to keep joins and transactions inside a sharding key and how to make sharding reversible.
authority_rationale: Official engineering blog of a major technology company describing its own production system.
notes: Rejected CockroachDB, TiDB, Spanner, Vitess and NoSQL. Citus is not mentioned.

title: Herding elephants: Lessons learned from sharding Postgres at Notion
engineering_principles: Shard before load removes migration headroom; verify independently; merge partition key into the primary key.
practical_examples: 480 logical shards on 32 physical databases, each logical shard a Postgres schema; 480 chosen for its many factors; audit-log replay instead of direct dual writes; about three-day backfill comparing record versions; five-minute switchover.
why_it_matters: Concrete shard-count arithmetic and a retrospective on primary-key design for tenant sharding.
authority_rationale: Official engineering blog of a major technology company describing its own production system.
notes: Rejected vertical scaling, Citus, Vitess, DynamoDB and bare-metal NVMe.

title: The Great Re-shard: adding Postgres capacity (again) with zero downtime
organization_author: Notion / Arka Ganguli, Tanner Johnson, Ben Kraft, Nathan Northcutt
engineering_principles: Keep logical shards above physical hosts so capacity changes move shards; plan the connection-pool layer as its own scaling dimension.
practical_examples: 32 to 96 databases (15 to 5 schemas each); deferring index builds cut sync from 3 days to 12 hours; PgBouncer split into groups; four-step failover with reversed replication for rollback.
why_it_matters: Demonstrates the payoff of logical sharding and exposes connection limits as a hidden constraint.
authority_rationale: Official engineering blog of a major technology company describing its own production system.
notes: Peak CPU and IOPS fell to about 20%; no perceived user downtime reported.

authority_rationale: Official engineering blog of a major technology company describing its own production system.
